name: WLEO
rootCause: The WLEO contract of the Ethereum project was hacked, resulting in the theft of $42,000 worth of funds. The hackers stole Ethereum from the pool of the decentralized exchange Uniswap by casting WLEO to themselves and replacing it with Ethereum.

descriptions.text: The WLEO contract of the Ethereum project was hacked, resulting in the theft of $42,000 worth of funds. The hackers stole Ethereum from the pool of the decentralized exchange Uniswap by casting WLEO to themselves and replacing it with Ethereum.

On October 11, 2020, WLEO was exploited on Ethereum by an attacker who used the compromised contract key to mint unbacked tokens, extracting approximately $42,000 from the Uniswap liquidity pool. Rapid community response limited further loss, but the vulnerability allowed infinite minting. The exploit was caused by key compromise. The attacker obtained the private key controlling the WLEO contract and used it to mint unbacked tokens, enabling infinite mint and draining assets from the liquidity pool.
